name: Duplicate & Similar File Finder
tagline: Find duplicate files, near-identical photos, the biggest space hogs and empty folders on your own disk — then let your AI help you clean up safely.

actions.label: Find duplicate files
actions.description: Finds files with exactly the same content anywhere in a folder (and its subfolders), even if their names differ — photos copied twice, downloads saved again, backups of backups. Writes a report grouped by duplicate set. Nothing is deleted.
actions.mcpDescription: Find exact duplicate files (same content, any name) in a folder tree on the user's computer, offline (Czkawka, BLAKE3 hashes) and write a grouped report to `out`. Use for 'free up space', 'find duplicate photos/files', 'clean up my Downloads/Pictures/backup drive'. `minsize` skips small files. Nothing is deleted or moved: it only writes a report. Read the report, show the user what you found (groups, sizes, paths) and ask before deleting anything; when they agree, delete only the files they approved, keeping one copy of each group.

actions.label: Find similar photos
actions.description: Finds photos that look the same even when they aren’t identical files — resized copies, re-saved JPGs, burst shots, edits of the same picture. Writes a report grouped by look-alike set. Nothing is deleted.
actions.mcpDescription: Find visually similar or near-duplicate photos (resized, re-compressed, edited copies, burst shots) in a folder tree on the user's computer, offline (Czkawka perceptual hashes), and write a grouped report to `out`. `similarity`: strict finds only near-identical copies, loose also finds similar shots. Nothing is deleted or moved: it only writes a report. Read the report, show the user what you found (groups, sizes, paths) and ask before deleting anything; when they agree, delete only the files they approved, keeping one copy of each group.

actions.label: Find the biggest files
actions.description: Lists the biggest files in a folder tree so you can see what is filling your disk.
actions.mcpDescription: List the biggest files in a folder tree on the user's computer (Czkawka) and write them to `out`, largest first. Use for 'what is taking up my disk space' or 'find large files I can delete or archive'. Nothing is deleted or moved: it only writes a report. Read the report, show the user what you found (groups, sizes, paths) and ask before deleting anything; when they agree, delete only the files they approved, keeping one copy of each group.

actions.label: Find empty folders
actions.description: Lists folders that contain no files at all (only empty subfolders, or nothing).
actions.mcpDescription: List empty folders (no files anywhere inside) in a folder tree on the user's computer (Czkawka) and write them to `out`. Nothing is deleted or moved: it only writes a report. Read the report, show the user what you found (groups, sizes, paths) and ask before deleting anything; when they agree, delete only the files they approved, keeping one copy of each group.
